Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Come to think of it, we don't really get to do New Year's calligraphy anymore.
Yeah... If someone told me to do it now, I probably wouldn't be very confident.
You face the paper and focus your mind. Clear your thoughts, then let the brush fly.
Haha, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I bet you have great handwriting. You give off 'beautiful calligrapher' vibes.
Flattery will get you nowhere, you know?
I'm serious.
Well, I hate to ruin the compliment, but I'm actually not that good at it.
Really? That's surprising.
Writing the characters is fine, but grinding the ink is tough. You don't use bottled ink for that, right?
Ah, true.
Just grinding the ink wipes me out. You know I'm not good at exercising.
(Is grinding ink... considered exercise?)
Anegasaki
I wonder what I should do for the coming-of- age ceremony...
Eh？
？ Why are you so surprised?
Because you made it sound like you're doing it this year.
Of course not. I mean for the future.
Haha, right. Like what you're going to wear?
Yeah, which do you think is better?
Hmm, probably a kimono, right? You don't get many chances to wear one.
I see, a hakama...
Eh？
A suit would look great too, but you can wear a suit anytime, right?♪
(...She was talking about ●!?)
February means Setsubun is coming up...
Anegasaki
Having to eat your age in beans feels like a cruel joke, doesn't it?
You really don't need to worry about that.
But still.
Even if you're supposed to eat your age, that's a lot of beans. I don't think you have to follow it that strictly.
I suppose...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how many are you planning to eat?
Seve...
Umm... I'm gonna eat thwee, ▼
Jeez, don't look so put off!
(I just thought it was cute, though...)
Sigh... It's still so cold. Spring feels so far away.
Anegasaki
Jeez. Don't talk like an old man.
But it's true...
No 'buts'. Spring is just around the corner. You just haven't noticed it yet.
Like what？
You know that house near the school with the plum tree? I saw some little buds starting to open up.
Wow, I didn't notice at all. I always just walk right past it.
If you look closely, I bet you can find lots of little signs of spring.
Hmm... Maybe I'd feel spring if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ dressed a bit lighter？
Just kidding.
Pervert!
(She got mad at me...)
Did ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ celebrate Hinamatsuri too？
Anegasaki
...Past tense, huh.
Eh？
I'll have you know I'm still a proper girl.
Sorry... Do you celebrate Hinamatsuri？
Well, not anymore. I did when I was little, though.
(So it is past tense, after all...)
That's not the point. It's about how I feel.
Right？
(Did my face give it away...？)
Yep, it was written all over your face.
(Please don't reply to my inner thoughts...)
Anegasaki
Hey. When you think of spring flowers, what comes to mind？
Hmm... Cherry blossoms, I guess.
I knew it. But it's too early for cherry blossoms, right？ It's the Peach Festival now.
Come to think of it, some houses have them blooming in their yards.
I saw a little potted plant at the florist the other day, and I just had to buy it.
It has tiny buds on it. It's so much fun watching them slowly open up.
Wow. I'd like to see ●'s too.
Hmm... Does that mean you want to come over to my place？
Huh？ That's not what I...
Right, I could just take a picture and show you. Right？
(I wouldn't exactly be satisfied with just that...)
Anegasaki
There was an entrance ceremony at the local kindergarten recently. They were all so tiny and cute.
Come to think of it, it is that time of year.
They looked so innocent, not used to being in a group yet... Hm...？ What's wrong？
You just had this really gentle look on your face. It was nice.
Flattery will get you nowhere.
I mean it. I think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ would make a perfect kindergarten teacher.
Is that so？
Definitely! I bet the kids would love their sweet Ms. Nene.
But before being surrounded by lots of kids...
...Hmm？
I think just one is plenty.
(...What does she mean by that？)
Anegasaki
You know how April is called Uzuki in the old calendar？
Yeah, originally the fourth month of the lunar calendar, right？
Well, once I accidentally read it as Tamago-zuki (Egg Month).
Haha! The kanji do look pretty similar.
Ugh, it was so embarrassing. My face turned bright red.
When did this happen？
...A long time ago, okay？
Like... elementary school？ Then it's no surprise you couldn't read it.
Maybe a little less long ago than that？
Middle school, then？
Maybe a little more... recent than that？
(So it was recent...)
Anegasaki
Mother's Day is coming up. Have you thought about what to get her？
That look on your face. You totally forgot, didn't you？
...Hahaha.
Laughing it off won't work. You need to properly show your appreciation.
I just don't know what to get. Especially since we live so far apart.
I think it's the thought that counts.
I'm sure she'd be happy with just a carnation and a little message attached？
Yeah. I'll try to think of something.
Yeah. I hope she likes it.
You know kashiwa mochi？
Anegasaki
Yeah. It's for Children's Day, after all.
Right, right. Are you supposed to eat the leaf on those, too？
I mean... I don't eat it.
There's a guy in my class who insists you're supposed to.
Huh... Oh, maybe he's confusing them with sakura mochi？
Really？
Sakura mochi uses salted cherry leaves, so some eat them. But I don't think you usually eat kashiwa leaves.
Wow. You even know a lot about traditional sweets, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I wouldn't call it a lot... Mmm, now I kind of want some. What're you gonna do about it？
Wait, isn't this your fault, ●？
It's because you brought up sweets in the first place, jeez!
(Aw, man...)
Anegasaki
Hey.
...Hmm？
Do you remember Father's Day？
Ah... when was that again？
Aren't you going to get him a present？
Well, you know, since we live so far apart and all.
I think that's exactly why you should get him something？
Hmm... you really think so？
I do. Okay？
(Guess I'll think of something...)
Anegasaki
It's the season for June brides, isn't it？
Oh, right. Is that something you dream about？
Of course it is!?
I guess it's a given.
It goes without saying. Every June, I find myself thinking about it. 'How nice, I want that too.'
Every year, huh... Since when？
Hmm, I feel like I was already thinking that in elementary school... Maybe even earlier.
Since you were that little？ I don't think ● even knew what marriage was back then.
I probably wasn't that different. I doubt I really understood it either. It's much more concrete now.
Well, at our age, yeah.
...Age is part of it, but what became concrete is... my partner, I guess.
It's full-on summer now. It's getting pretty tough without the AC.
Anegasaki
But for girls, it's also a season that causes a lot of headaches.
Why？
The AC is blasting everywhere, right？ If we dress too light, we end up freezing.
I see. Girls have to deal with that kind of struggle, huh.
Right. It's not as simple as 'lucky, they're dressed light'.
I don't think that at all！
Really？
I mean it！
Hmm？
...Um, maybe that's just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
Eh... Hmm... I guess that's barely acceptable, then.
(Barely, huh...)
Anegasaki
I want to wear a yukata and go to the summer festival together.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a yukata... Yeah, that's definitely nice.
...Hey.
Eh？
Is a yukata really something that makes you drool that much？ I mean, it's cute, but...
I-I'm not drooling.
You were drooling a lot.
No I wasn't！
Uh-huh, you had a really sloppy look on your face... But it was a little...
...Hmm？
Maybe it was a little cute...▼
(Uh... I have mixed feelings about that.)
It's gotten even hotter lately. I don't even want to step outside anymore.
Anegasaki
But if you stay cooped up in the AC all day, you'll end up getting sick.
Aren't you hot, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Clear your mind, and even fire will feel cool... Just kidding.
It's still hot, of course, but I try to set the temp a bit higher for my health.
I see. Maybe ● should be a little careful too...
Right. Once your autonomic nervous system gets messed up, it's hard to recover.
If that happens, I won't be able to hang out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe. You sure know what to say.
But it's true, your body isn't just yours anymore. Right？
Anegasaki
Hey. Summer vacation is almost over. Have you been doing your homework？
I'd love to say I'm all done, but...
Geez. You shouldn't leave it until the last minute.
I was having too much fun hanging out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
No excuses. But... I guess I'm partly to blame, too.
I'm kidding. It's ●'s fault you still have homework.
This is when your big sister should step in and make sure you get it done, but...
Are you gonna help me？
Actually, I haven't finished mine at all either...
What?!
And this is your fault, too, you know.
(What?!)
Anegasaki
Look, you're spacing out again.
Eh？
Were you slacking off during summer vacation？
My sleep schedule still isn't back to normal.
Snap out of your summer daze soon, or you'll end up falling asleep in class.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ doesn't seem to have any summer daze at all.
That's because I made sure to keep a regular routine.
Wow, that's impressive.
A bad sleep schedule is bad for my skin, so staying up late is strictly forbidden.
I see.
So this time, I win♪
(What were we competing in？)
I saw steamed buns at the convenience store the other day. They're already out.
Anegasaki
Wait, already？
Autumn is the season for appetites, but it feels like it comes earlier every year.
...Autumn appetites, huh. It's already that time of year.
Why the sigh？
It's the hardest time of year for girls trying to diet.
I see. But I don't think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ needs to lose any weight.
I'm happy you think so, but...
At the end of the day, this is more of a personal issue!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ worries about it way too much.)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems kind of excited.
Anegasaki
Hehe, it's almost time for the sales to start.
Girls really love sales, huh.
I think boys should learn to love them more, too.
Maybe, but we can't compete. Some people even say the venue is like a battlefield.
I don't think I could go that far. The most I can do is line up early.
It's amazing you can even line up. ● would probably give up just seeing the line.
Girls will spare no effort when it comes to being pretty♪
Anegasaki
Hey, look. The shopping street is completely decked out in Halloween decorations.
Wow. It's already that time of year. But... haha.
Did I say something weird？
It's just that it was kinda cute seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ so excited.
Geez. Even I get excited sometimes, you know.
Are you thinking about dressing up or something？
Let's see... Since it's Halloween, how about a witch costume？
Trick or treat! ...Just kidding？
That'd definitely be cute. I'd love to see it.
Hehe. Well then... If I get the chance, okay？
Anegasaki
When you walk down tree-lined streets, doesn't it feel like fall is over？
Just the other day the leaves were changing colors, and now they're falling.
It's a little sad, but a path covered in fallen leaves is beautiful in its own way.
The smell of ginkgo nuts can be a bit tough to handle, though.
Geez! I don't like people with no tact.
Sorry, sorry.
And here I was trying to be romantic.
Do you hate ginkgo nuts？
No, I like them？ In chawanmushi, or just roasted on their own.
Then it's fine! Ginkgo nuts!
I guess... Ah, geez. That's not the point!
(She's kinda cute...)
Anegasaki
We should probably start prepping for finals soon.
Even ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ needs to prep for finals？
Of course. My grades aren't actually all that amazing？
Really. I just kind of had that image of you.
I take classes pretty seriously, take good notes, and... well, I do my homework properly.
You're an honor student.
Being an honor student and getting top grades are two different things.
When it comes to the actual test, I just... I wonder why？
Hmm, maybe you choke under pressure.
I wonder if that's it. Hmm...
It's suddenly gotten cold lately.
Anegasaki
Yeah. Looks like my knitting won't be done in time for real winter.
Knitting？ Could that be for ●...？
Ah... That's not it. Sorry.
Hehe. Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not planning to give it to anyone.
Then why...？
Because when I give something to someone special, I want them to be happy with it.
So I'm currently training hard so I can knit well.
Oh...
...Relieved？ Once I get good at it, I'll make you one, okay？
Are you getting ready for the big cleaning at your place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Well, I guess I'm just starting with what I can...
Oh？ Is it actually surprisingly messy？
Jeez. It's not like that at all.
Haha, I figured.
What about you？ Are the hidden spots in your room doing okay？
My place... I don't think it's that bad.
I sure hope so.
But wouldn't it be better to tidy up a little at a time now, rather than rushing at the end of the year？
All right~
Yes, that's good.
Anegasaki
Did you see the New Year's special？ The Celebrity Secret Talent Show.
Ah, yeah, that was on.
Aw, that's it？ I was so glued to it from start to finish that I almost forgot to eat.
You really like those secret talents, huh.
Yeah, I always look forward to it. Every year someone tries an even harder trick, and it just doesn't feel like the new year until I see it.
Oh, the comedian who always comes on last, right？ I know what you mean.
Plus, seeing nervous rookies makes me want to cheer them on, and seeing actors who usually play extras stand out makes me feel like they've grown up so much...
...You sound like a mom.
Hm？ What was that？
Nothing, nothing at all.
Anegasaki
Hey, don't you think a lot of New Year's food is hard for kids to eat？
Maybe. Like the simmered dishes and pickled stuff.
I didn't really like it when I was little either, so I hardly touched it. After that, my mom stopped making it...
Ah, I can see that happening.
She'd make ozouni, but no osechi. Instead, we always had hand-rolled sushi on New Year's Day.
Oh, that sounds nice too. A lot of people around ● don't eat osechi either.
Maybe when it's my turn, I'll try making osechi that even kids can enjoy.
When it's time for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah. And of course, I'll keep your tastes in mind too.
(●'s tastes？ Does that mean...)
Anegasaki
Hey, they say spring is near once the first day of spring passes, but that's not really true, is it？
I guess that's how it's supposed to work, though.
When you hear on the news or weather forecast that today is the first day of spring, you expect it to get warmer, right？
Yeah, you end up thinking it's already spring, even though it's still cold.
Exactly. I'd understand if it was early March, or at least late February.
The first day of spring is in early February, right？
Yeah. So spring is supposed to be getting closer, but...
Premature excitement again this year, huh...
Yeah. It's cold... Hey, can I hold your hand？
Ah, of course.
...Ah, my impression of the first day of spring might've just gotten a little better.
Haha, ● too.
It's cold...
Anegasaki
It's only cold if you think it is. Come on, stand up straight, okay？
You're so tough, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I always wonder though, aren't girls' uniforms freezing？
Nope. As long as you keep your neck and waist warm, bare legs are fine, see？
I don't know, it makes me cold just looking at them...
Jeez... Ah.
Eh？
You aren't looking at other girls like that, are you？ Staring at their legs while saying they look cold...
Well, sometimes my eyes just wander...
U-Um, I don't mean it in a weird way or anything!
I don't want to hear it.
(Agh, I said it's not like that...)
Did you know the date of the vernal equinox changes every year？
Anegasaki
Huh？ Isn't it March 20th？
It's been the 21st before. I figured you'd be curious too, ●, so I looked it up.
Is that so. Why does the date change？
That's...
Uh-huh.
...Sorry, I looked it up, but I forgot. It was complicated.
Too bad. You would've looked so cool if you could answer that smoothly~.
Ugh...
But I love how you get so honestly bummed out too. You're so cute, ▼.
...I'd rather be cool.
Hehe, then do your best.
Anegasaki
...Achoo!
Are you okay？ Do you have hay fever or something？
No, I don't. My nose just tickled a little. ...Achoo!
Are you sure it's not a cold？ Or maybe it is hay fever...
I said no, it's definitely not hay fever. I'd rather it be a cold.
Really？ You seem pretty energetic, so if anything it's probably hay fever...
Jeez, I'm gonna get mad, you know？
...Sorry. But...
They say hay fever beats you once you admit you have it, right？ Once you get it, it comes back every year!
Is it really a matter of admitting it or not？
It is. I've been getting by every year by pretending I don't notice it. ...Achoo!
(Every year...)
Anegasaki
Yawn...
Ah, staying up late？
Hehe. TV keeps me pretty busy around this time of year.
Ah, the new shows？ Is there anything good on？
I'm in the middle of looking for some. Especially with dramas, it's awful if you miss the first episode, right？ My recordings are piling up...
...You're watching all of them.
Yeah. I take my friends' opinions into account, but I have to see for myself. Even if the first episode is meh, the second might be good...
If you do that, won't you end up watching them all？
If it's boring after three episodes, I'll drop it. Three is my limit.
You really love TV, huh...
I'm a TV addict. I just hate the feeling of missing out on something good.
(She really does love it...)
Anegasaki
Spring is all about cherry blossom viewing, right？
Yeah. But aren't the cherry blossoms about to fall？
Cherry blossoms aren't the only flowers, you know？ There's canola flowers, tulips, dandelions... Lots of kinds.
...Flower viewing with dandelions？
After spring, there are hydrangeas, sunflowers, cosmos...
Huh？ I thought we were talking about spring.
I'm saying we can go flower viewing without cherry blossoms. Right？
(So basically, she just wants to go on dates all the time？)
Anegasaki
I should start getting ready for summer soon...
Ready for summer？ Like getting your swimsuit out？
Jeez. I mean dealing with the humidity. If I don't do it now, mold will grow everywhere.
Ah, the rainy season is pretty damp, huh.
Putting dehumidifiers in the closet and anti-mold spray in the bath makes things easier later.
Huh. Should ● do that at home too, I wonder？
Of course. I'm going shopping for supplies soon, so want me to do it for you？
For ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I'd love that, but... I'd feel bad.
Really？ Jeez, you don't have to hold back with me.
Come to think of it, you don't see koinobori much lately.
Anegasaki
Yeah. Hey, Dexee's was having a Children's Day fair recently, right？ With koinobori flags on the kids' meals.
Ah, they were giving out mini koinobori as a bonus.
I saw a kid asking their mom about it. They were like, 'What's this？'
...Which means they didn't know what koinobori are？
Seems like it. I wonder if kids these days are all like that.
Huh... I think it'd be good to teach kids about those seasonal festivals, though.
Hmm？
● might not know much about events either, but it's just common sense.
How reliable. You'll make a great dad, won't you？
You... think so？
Hehe, you're blushing.
Anegasaki
This is the time of year when the days are longest.
The summer solstice？
Yeah. It stays light out so late in summer, I used to break my curfew a lot...
You had a curfew？
In elementary school, I was told to be home by 5.
Huh. Did you get yelled at when you broke it？
A little. But they'd forgive me right away if I properly apologized.
...Must be nice being a girl.
Is it tough being a boy？
Yeah. Boys have it rough.
Hehe, you're weird.
Anegasaki
*Sigh* I feel so down...
You okay？ Are you feeling sick？
No, it's not that. It's just, with this low pressure system, my body feels so heavy.
Ah, it is the rainy season. ...Is it really because of the low pressure？
Yeah. When it's raining or about to, my body gets heavy and my head gets foggy. Does that happen to you？
I mean, the humidity feels gross, but...
I see. A lot of my friends are affected by low pressure too. Maybe it's a girl thing？
Is there anyone like that around ●...? Are you sure you don't need a doctor？
It's just the weather. I just feel a little sluggish.
...Are you sure it's not just in your head？
It's not. Unlike you, I'm actually delicate.
(...Is ● just dense？)
Anegasaki
Hey, what do you think Marine Day is all about？
When you think of the ocean, it's gotta be...
Girls in swimsuits, right？
No, that's not it... Though I won't deny it either.
Ah, you just imagined it. You've got a goofy look on your face.
No I don't! ...Okay, maybe just a little.
I appreciate your honesty. Then maybe beach houses？ Shaved ice, yakisoba...
That sounds good too. But still, when you talk about the ocean...
Hmm, white clouds and blue skies？ It feels so nice just looking at them~.
I get that. But it's not just about looking...
Of course, the sound of the waves and the smell of the tide too. Sea breezes are the best! Right？
(Is she trying to avoid talking about swimming...?)
It's summer gift season...
Anegasaki
What's wrong？ You sound like a middle-aged office worker.
Eh, is that the image you get？
Isn't it？ It feels like company workers sending gifts around to say 'thanks for your support'.
That might be how it actually is... But weren't summer gifts fun as a kid？ Like the juice boxes.
Really？ I don't have many memories of exchanging summer gifts at my house.
Really？
I think it depends on your dad's job. For year-end gifts, it seems relatives exchange them.
If you like summer gifts so much, want me to send you one？ Would a juice set be good？
Eh, no thanks. I was talking about when I was a kid.
Hehe, you're still a kid now, so nothing's changed, right？
Anegasaki
I guess it's time for late-summer greeting cards...
Postcards？ You send those？
Just to my grandpa and grandma, though？ They always send me one.
Oh, yeah？ Every year？
Yeah. Along with seasonal greetings, they also send me birthday cards.
They really dote on you, huh.
Hehe. But their grandkid is terrible at writing, so my replies are always late. If I write one now, it'll be a late-summer greeting.
You seem like the type to be on top of that stuff, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I'm only on top of things when it comes to you. *Sigh* If only I could just shoot them a quick text.
(She just casually said something super sweet...)
Anegasaki
Whenever Obon rolls around, I remember this one time I got scolded...
To who？
By some old guy I didn't know. He came running at me looking furious and yelled his head off.
That's scary... What did you even do？
I was in elementary school, catching bugs with the neighborhood kids. There were tons of red dragonflies, so we caught a whole bunch, and then...
Ah, red dragonflies around Obon...
Right. They say our ancestors ride them, right？ I didn't know that until then.
So that's why you got scolded.
Yeah. We let all the dragonflies out of our cages at once and apologized over and over. We were like, 'We're so sorry, ancestors!'
The old guy was scary, but nighttime was even worse. I was terrified a ghost would come scold me.
Haha, well, you were just a kid.
So I'm still a little bad with red dragonflies even now. I do think they're cute, though.
Anegasaki
It's already autumn, huh. Even though it's still hot during the day.
If I sleep in light clothes, I end up waking up cold in the middle of the night.
You can't do that. You need to sleep warmly, or you'll catch a cold, you know？
But it's so hot when I first go to bed.
Jeez, you worry me. If we lived together, I'd make sure to tuck you in.
You say that, but I bet ● would be the one tucking ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in.
I don't toss and turn that much in my sleep.
It's not like ● tosses and turns either...
Is that so？ Hmm, I'll just have to see for myself.
Anegasaki
September is Be Kind to Animals Week, so they hold all sorts of events all over the place.
Oh, really？ What kind of events do they have？
Petting zoos in event spaces, traveling pets visiting schools and nursing homes... All sorts.
Wow, you know a lot about this.
There are tons of posters on the school bulletin board. You've seen them, right？
...Have I？
What？ The bunnies, the cats, the raccoons, the alpacas... You don't remember those adorable little guys？
Uh, sorry. Are the posters really that cute？
Oh, they're so soft and fluffy with big, round eyes... Agh, just thinking about them is too cute~ ▼
(...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is the cute one.)
Hey, what do you think is the best way to eat chestnuts？
Anegasaki
Hmm, you could make chestnut rice, boil them to eat as is, or make candied chestnuts... There's lots of ways. Why？
Just thinking it's that time of year, you know.
Maybe I'll make something for you, then...
Really？ Awesome!
Sweets could work, too. A store-bought Mont Blanc might be tough, but I could make a chestnut pound cake.
Wow, that's amazing. Just coming up with that so easily is impressive.
You're praising me a little too much...
Is that okay？ I feel like I kind of begged for it...
I'm happy when you ask, and I'm happy to make it for you. I'll think of something.
Anegasaki
Is it true that it's usually sunny on Sports Day？
Yeah, they say that.
Then if we made Sports Day into Tanabata, Orihime and Hikoboshi might have a better chance of meeting.
Haha. True, but doesn't Tanabata have to be on July 7th to mean anything？
Does it？ Sports Day used to be October 10th, but they changed it to the second Monday in October, right？
I think that's a bit different... Probably.
I think it'd be fine if Tanabata was in October and Sports Day was in July.
July might be a little too hot for exercising, though...
Then let's get rid of Sports Day. July 7th can be Lucky Seven Day. October 10th is Tanabata. How's that？ We don't need Sports Day, right？
(So that's her real motive...)
Anegasaki
The wind's getting chilly.
It's only going to get colder from here on out...
It's warm if we snuggle up, you know？ Hehe.
We can't be snuggled up all the time, right？ Like during class.
Well, obviously we can't do that... But the classroom is warm, right？
Depends on where you sit. It gets pretty drafty by the window. But it's hot near the heater.
Boys are so sensitive to both the cold and the heat. You have no endurance at all.
You're so strict, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
This winter, you'll be fine with a human heat pack right beside you. See？ Nice and toasty, right？
You're so sweet, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Jeez, you're such a smooth talker.
Anegasaki
Did you get the notice about flu shots？
Yeah. They handed out printouts in homeroom.
Do we really have to get them？
I doubt it's mandatory. Are you bad with needles？
Is anyone good with them？
